Chemical: 1. Remove and burn heavily infected leaves.
2. Mix 2 grams of Mancozeb powder in 1 liter of water.
3. Spray the solution thoroughly on both sides of the leaves.
Organic: 1. Remove infected leaves and bury them deep in soil.
2. Mix 5ml of Neem oil and 2 drops of liquid soap in 1 liter of water.
3. Spray every 7-10 days until symptoms stop.

PreventionTips: Rotate crops annually (avoid planting tomatoes or potatoes in the same spot)
Use mulch to prevent soil splashing onto leaves
Provide proper spacing between plants for better airflow
Water plants at the base, not on the foliage

LanguageOutput.English: Your tomato plant shows signs of Early Blight. Apply Mancozeb spray or neem oil immediately and remove affected leaves. Avoid overhead watering and rotate crops next season.
